name: EOSP WP-MVP-0003 Authorization Bootstrap

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - eosp/authorize-wp-mvp-0003-bootstrap

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  authorize:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout current main
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Reconcile, adopt, ready, and authorize WP-MVP-0003
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          git switch -c eosp/authorize-wp-mvp-0003

          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import json

          p = Path('engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0003.md')
          text = p.read_text()
          text = text.replace(
              '**Status:** Refined — blocked from Ready by workspace bootstrap and ADR-0005  ',
              '**Status:** Refined — prerequisites satisfied; pending EOS adoption/readiness evaluation  '
          )
          text = text.replace('- proposed ADR-0005', '- ADR-0005')
          text = text.replace(
              'WP-MVP-0001 root semantics and WP-MVP-0002 canonical discovery output must be stable. ADR-0005 must be accepted before implementation authorization.',
              '- WP-MVP-0001 is CLOSED and provides stable repository root/effective configuration semantics.\n- WP-MVP-0002 is CLOSED and provides stable canonical discovery output.\n- ADR-0005 is Accepted and establishes the authorized MVP implementation topology.'
          )
          p.write_text(text)

          manifest = {
              'schema_version': '1.0.0',
              'adoption_id': 'ADOPT-WP-MVP-0003-2026-08-16',
              'reason': 'Adopt the pre-existing WP-MVP-0003 planning artifact into canonical EOS lifecycle control after closure of WP-MVP-0001 and WP-MVP-0002 and acceptance of ADR-0005.',
              'evidence': [
                  'engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0001.md',
                  'engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0002.md',
                  'architecture/decisions/ADR-0003-stable-source-and-document-identity.md',
                  'architecture/decisions/ADR-0005-mvp-core-implementation-topology.md',
                  'specifications/data/DATA-SOURCE-0001-stable-source-and-document-identity.md',
                  'specifications/technical/TECH-WORKSPACE-0001-deterministic-workspace-discovery.md'
              ],
              'work_packets': [{
                  'id': 'WP-MVP-0003',
                  'path': 'engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0003.md',
                  'title': 'Stable source and document identity',
                  'status': 'DRAFT',
                  'pi': 'PI-MVP-001',
                  'wc': 'WC-MVP-0001',
                  'domain': 'CORE',
                  'created': '2026-08-12T00:00:00Z',
                  'updated': '2026-08-12T00:00:00Z',
                  'github_url': ''
              }]
          }
          out = Path('.eos/adoptions/wp-mvp-0003.json')
          out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
          out.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
          PY

          ./scripts/eos adopt .eos/adoptions/wp-mvp-0003.json --apply \
            --by 'Thomas Carter' \
            --reason 'Adopt WP-MVP-0003 after closure of its WP-MVP-0001 and WP-MVP-0002 dependencies and acceptance of ADR-0005.'

          ./scripts/eos gate explain WP_READY WP-MVP-0003
          ./scripts/eos ready WP-MVP-0003 \
            --by 'Thomas Carter' \
            --reason 'WP-MVP-0003 prerequisites and governing contracts are satisfied following closure of WP-MVP-0002.'

          ./scripts/eos gate explain WP_AUTHORIZE WP-MVP-0003
          ./scripts/eos authorize WP-MVP-0003 \
            --by 'Thomas Carter' \
            --reason 'Explicit human authorization to proceed with WP-MVP-0003 following closure of WP-MVP-0002.'

          # Refresh current evidence for already governed packets whose semantic source fingerprint changed.
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0001 --profile wp
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0002 --profile wp --execution EXEC-0004

          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check

          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import json, csv
          state = json.loads(Path('.eos/state/current.json').read_text())
          assert state['entities']['WP']['WP-MVP-0001']['lifecycle_state'] == 'CLOSED'
          assert state['entities']['WP']['WP-MVP-0002']['lifecycle_state'] == 'CLOSED'
          assert state['entities']['WP']['WP-MVP-0003']['lifecycle_state'] == 'AUTHORIZED'
          assert state['entities']['WC']['WC-MVP-0001']['lifecycle_state'] == 'ACTIVE'
          wp = Path('engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0003.md').read_text()
          assert '**Status:** AUTHORIZED' in wp
          assert 'proposed ADR-0005' not in wp
          assert 'WP-MVP-0002 is CLOSED' in wp
          PY

          git status --short
          git diff --stat
          git diff -- engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0003.md
          git diff -- .eos/work-packets.tsv

      - name: Commit authorization transaction
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          git config user.name 'PMB CI'
          git config user.email 'ci@pmb.test'
          git add -A
          git commit -m 'chore(eosp): authorize WP-MVP-0003'

      - name: Post-commit stability proof and push
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/eosp/authorize-wp-mvp-0003
